# Extra

Widgets in tabs, and leaflet.

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(quartoReactive)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(leaflet)
source("data.R")
transit <- transit_data()
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## First

Visible tab.

## Hidden

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_ly(qr_data(transit, "code", "gemeente"), x = ~name, y = ~pct_near_stop, type = "bar")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
datatable(qr_data(transit, "code", "gemeente"), rownames = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
qr_iconfill(transit, key = "code", value = "pct_near_stop", label = "name", param = "gemeente",
            icon = "person", duration = 300)
```

:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
leaflet(qr_data(area_points(), "code", "gemeente")) |>
  addTiles(urlTemplate = "") |>
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, label = ~name)
```
